22795-the-ontario-high-school-reader.title: High School Reader
22795-the-ontario-high-school-reader.creator: Unknown
22795-the-ontario-high-school-reader.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There are several reasons why every boy or girl should strive to become a good reader. In the first place, good oral reading is an accomplishment in itself. It affords a great deal of pleasure to others as well as to ourselves.

44281-recollections-of-the-war-of-1812.title: War of 1812
44281-recollections-of-the-war-of-1812.creator: Dr. Wm. Dunlop
44281-recollections-of-the-war-of-1812.description: A book by Dr. Wm. Dunlop. WILLIAM DUNLOP,   a man  of  surpassing  talent,  knowledge,  and benevolence, born in Scotland  in 1792. He served in the army in Canada and in India  and thereafter distinguished himself  as an author and man of  letters. He settled in Canada permanently in 1825 and  for more than 20 years was actively  engaged in public and philanthropic  affairs. Succeeding his brother, Capt. Dunlop, as Member  of the Provincial Parliament and  taking successful interest in  the welfare of Canada,  and died lamented  by many  friends  1848.

arxiv-2006-03582.title: The one that got away: A unique eclipse in the young brown dwarf Roque 12
arxiv-2006-03582.creator: Aleks Scholz, Dirk Froebrich, Koraljka Muzic, Jochen Eislöffel
arxiv-2006-03582.description: Abstract We report the discovery of a deep, singular eclipse of the bona fide brown dwarf Roque 12, a substellar member of the Pleiades. The eclipse was 0.65 mag deep, lasted 1.3 h, and was observed with two telescopes simultaneously in October 2002. No further eclipse was recorded, despite continuous monitoring with Kepler/K2 over 70 d in 2015.

arxiv-2007-05004.title: Higgs sector phenomenology in the 3-3-1 model with an axionlike particle
arxiv-2007-05004.creator: V. H. Binh a,b, D. T. Binh c,d, A. E. Cárcamo Hernández e,f,g, D. T. Huong b, D. V. Soa h, H. N. Long k,l
arxiv-2007-05004.description: Abstract The scalar sector of the 3-3-1 model with an axionlike particle is studied in detail. In the model under consideration, there are two kinds of scalar fields: the bilepton scalars carrying lepton number two and the ordinary ones without lepton number. We show that there is no mixing among these two kinds of scalar fields.

arxiv-2111-13249.title: Graph-based Interpretation of Normal Logic Programs
arxiv-2111-13249.creator: Fang Li, Elmer Salazar, Gopal Gupta
arxiv-2111-13249.description: Abstract In this paper we present a dependency graph-based method for computing the various semantics of normal logic programs. Our method employs conjunction nodes to unambiguously represent the dependency graph of normal logic programs. The dependency graph can be transformed suitably in a semantics preserving manner and re-translated into a equivalent normal logic program.

arxiv-2208-13244.title: Assessing the Impact of Execution Environment on Observation-Based Slicing
arxiv-2208-13244.creator: David Binkley 1 Leon Moonen 4
arxiv-2208-13244.description: Abstract Program slicing reduces a program to a smaller version that retains a chosen computation, referred to as a slicing criterion . One recent multi-lingual slicing approach, observation-based slicing (ORBS) , speculatively deletes parts of the program and then executes the code. If the behavior of the slicing criteria is unchanged, the speculative deletion is made permanent.

arxiv-2211-13022.title: Molecular Berry curvatures and the adiabatic response tensors
arxiv-2211-13022.creator: Raffaele Resta
arxiv-2211-13022.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Raffaele Resta. Adiabatic transport in a many-electron system is expressed in terms of the appropriate Berry curvature, owing to the Niu-Thouless theory [J. Phys A 17 , 2453 (1984)]; the main equation is very compact and very general. I address here three paradigmatic adiabatic response tensors—-the atomic polar tensor, the atomic axial tensor, and the rotational g g factor—and I show that, for all of them, the known formulas do not need an independent proof.

arxiv-2301-05144.title: The implications of large binding energies of massive stripped core collapse supernova progenitors on the explosion mechanism
arxiv-2301-05144.creator: Dmitry Shishkin, Noam Soker
arxiv-2301-05144.description: Abstract We examine the binding energies of massive stripped-envelope core collapse supernova (SECCSN) progenitors with the stellar evolution code mesa , and find that the jittering jets explosion mechanism is preferred for explosions where carbon-oxygen cores with masses of ≳ 20 ​ M ⊙ \gtrsim 20M_{\odot} collapse to leave a neutron star (NS) remnant.

arxiv-2307-02006.title: PULSAR at MEDIQA-Sum 2023: Large Language Models Augmented by Synthetic Dialogue Convert Patient Dialogues to Medical Records
arxiv-2307-02006.creator: Viktor Schlegel, Hao Li, Yuping Wu, Anand Subramanian, Thanh-Tung Nguyen, Abhinav Ramesh Kashyap, Daniel Beck, Xiaojun Zeng, Riza Theresa Batista-Navarro, Stefan Winkler, Goran Nenadic
arxiv-2307-02006.description: Abstract This paper describes PULSAR, our system submission at the ImageClef 2023 MediQA-Sum task on summarising patient-doctor dialogues into clinical records. The proposed framework relies on domain-specific pre-training, to produce a specialised language model which is trained on task-specific natural data augmented by synthetic data generated by a black-box LLM.

arxiv-2406-02699.title: Operational Latent Spaces
arxiv-2406-02699.creator: Scott H. Hawley 1,2, Austin R. Tackett 1
arxiv-2406-02699.description: Abstract \footertext Preprint. Accepted for 2024 AES International Symposium on AI and the Musician 1 Introduction Self-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful tool for uncovering latent representations within data. These latent spaces, often high-dimensional, capture the underlying structure of the data in a way that can be surprisingly meaningful.

arxiv-2410-04766.title: Efficient sampling using Macrocanonical Monte Carlo and density of states mapping
arxiv-2410-04766.creator: Jiewei Ding, Jiahao Su, Ho-Kin Tang, Wing Chi Yu
arxiv-2410-04766.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiewei Ding, Jiahao Su, Ho-Kin Tang, Wing Chi Yu. In the context of Monte Carlo sampling for lattice models, the complexity of the energy landscape often leads to Markov chains being trapped in local optima, thereby increasing the correlation between samples and reducing sampling efficiency. This study proposes a Monte Carlo algorithm that effectively addresses the irregularities of the energy landscape through the introduction of the estimated density of states.

arxiv-2412-12271.title: Heavy Neutral Leptons without Prejudice
arxiv-2412-12271.creator: Nicolás Bernal, Kuldeep Deka, and Marta Losada
arxiv-2412-12271.description: Abstract Heavy Neutral Leptons (HNLs) provide a compelling extension to the Standard Model, addressing the neutrino masses, baryogenesis, and dark matter problems. We perform a model-independent collider study, decoupling the active-sterile mixing angle ( V V ) from the Yukawa coupling ( y y ), and explore sensitivities at the HL-LHC for prompt and displaced decays.

arxiv-2507-16298.title: WhatsApp Tiplines and Multilingual Claims in the 2021 Indian Assembly Elections
arxiv-2507-16298.creator: Gautam Kishore Shahi, Scott A. Hale
arxiv-2507-16298.description: Abstract WhatsApp tiplines, first launched in 2019 to combat misinformation, enable users to interact with fact-checkers to verify misleading content. This study analyzes 580 unique claims (tips) from 451 users, covering both high-resource languages (English, Hindi) and a low-resource language (Telugu) during the 2021 Indian assembly elections using a mixed-method approach.

arxiv-2509-11033.title: CHOQUET INTEGRATION WITH SUBMODULAR FUNCTION ON MEASURABLE SPACE WITH SIGMA-ALGEBRA GENERATING CHAIN
arxiv-2509-11033.description: Abstract Based on a study of a formula representing submodular set function as a supremum of measures dominated by the set function, we present a corresponding formula for a Choquet integration with respect to the set function, on a measurable space which has a chain of measurable set generating the sigma-algebra.

arxiv-2509-22871.title: Probing the Star Formation Main Sequence down to 10 M ⊙ 7 {}^{7}\,M_{\odot} at 1 < z < 9 1<z<9
arxiv-2509-22871.creator: Rosa M. Mérida, Marcin Sawicki, Kartheik G. Iyer, Gaël Noirot, Chris J. Willott, Maruša Bradač, Guillaume Desprez, Nicholas S. Martis, Adam Muzzin, Gregor Rihtaršič, Ghassan T. E. Sarrouh, Jeremy Favaro, Gaia Gaspar, Anishya Harshan, Jon Judež
arxiv-2509-22871.description: Abstract The Main Sequence of Star-Forming Galaxies (SFGMS or MS) is a fundamental scaling relation that provides a global framework for studying galaxy formation and evolution, as well as insight into the complex star formation histories (SFHs) of individual galaxies.

arxiv-2510-26943.title: Observation and Modeling of Shear Evolution of Post-reconnection Flare Loops
arxiv-2510-26943.creator: Drake Osaben, Jiong Qiu, Dana W. Longcope
arxiv-2510-26943.description: Abstract A solar flare releases magnetic energy by reconnecting field lines across a current sheet, thereby allowing their relaxation to a lower energy state. The maximum possible energy is released if all field lines relax to a current-free (potential) state.

arxiv-2512-21395.title: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to Synthetic Data Generation
arxiv-2512-21395.creator: Natalia Espinosa Dice, Nicholas J Jackson, Chao Yan, Aaron Lee, Bradley A Malin
arxiv-2512-21395.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Natalia Espinosa Dice, Nicholas J Jackson, Chao Yan, Aaron Lee, Bradley A Malin. Synthetic data generation (SDG) is a promising approach for enabling data sharing in biomedical studies while preserving patient privacy. Yet, state-of-the-art generative models often require large datasets and complex training procedures, limiting their applicability in small-sample settings.

pmc-11349700.title: Optimizing sheep B-cell epitopes in Echinococcus granulosus recombinant antigen P29 for vaccine development
pmc-11349700.creator: Jihui Yang, Yongxue Lv, Yazhou Zhu, Jiahui Song, Mingxing Zhu, Changyou Wu, Yong Fu, Wei Zhao, Yinqi Zhao
pmc-11349700.description: Background Echinococcus granulosus is a widespread zoonotic parasitic disease, significantly impacting human health and livestock development; however, no vaccine is currently available for humans. Our preliminary studies indicate that recombinant antigen P29 (rEg.P29) is a promising candidate for vaccine.MethodsSheep were immunized with rEg.P29, and venous blood was collected at various time points.

pmc-11477461.title: Experiences in Awake Craniotomy from Borneo: A Case Series from Sarawak General Hospital
pmc-11477461.creator: Kugan Vijian, Bik Liang Lau, Davendran Kanesen, Swee San Lim, Peter Chee Seong Tan, Donald San Liew Ngian, Albert Hieng Sii Wong
pmc-11477461.description: BackgroundThe indications for awake craniotomy now spans from resection of tumours at eloquent areas of the brain, deep brain stimulation and treatment of aneurysms to name a few. In the region of East Malaysia where patients have various ethnic backgrounds and native languages, planning and execution of these procedures can be somewhat challenging.

pmc-12592950.title: Enhanced Surgical Recovery Nursing Program: A Focus on Initiation of Early Feeding and Mobilization Following Elective Abdominal Surgery
pmc-12592950.creator: Hezil Reema Barboza, MS Moosabba, Amar Sunil Lobo
pmc-12592950.description: Background and aimsPostoperative nursing care plays a crucial role in improving outcomes and enhancing the recovery of patients undergoing abdominal surgery. Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols have been shown to significantly reduce postoperative complications and length of hospital stay by promoting early mobilization and faster recovery.

pmc-12729774.title: Inactivated Type ‘O’ Foot and Mouth Disease Virus Encapsulated in Chitosan Nanoparticles Induced Protective Immune Response in Guinea Pigs
pmc-12729774.creator: Kalaivanan Ramya, Subodh Kishore, Palanisamy Sankar, Ganesh Kondabatulla, Bedaso Mamo Edao, Ramasamy Saravanan, Kumaraguruban Karthik
pmc-12729774.description: Simple SummaryThe efficacy of nanoparticle-delivered inactivated FMDV in inducing mucosal and systemic immune responses was studied in a guinea pig model. The chitosan nanoparticles encapsulating inactivated FMDV antigen (FMDV-CS-NPs) were prepared by the incubation method and their properties characterized. The immune response and protective efficiency of the FMDV-CS-NPs administered through intranasal and intramuscular routes were evaluated.

pmc-13285824.title: ERBB2/HER2 landscape and prognostic impact: large-scale, real-world analysis across solid cancers
pmc-13285824.creator: A. Shreenivas, A. Elliott, T. Corbiere, H.-Z. Chen, B. George, M. Kamgar, S. Chakrabarti, A. Desai, D. Bracken-Clarke, E. Xue, C.S. Floudas, J. Thomas, J. Xiu, G. Sledge, E.S. Antonarakis, Y. Boumber, R. Kurzrock

pmc-13355592.title: Intra- and inter-multi-omics interaction analysis using deep learning
pmc-13355592.creator: Mingon Kang, Eunyoung Jang, Tesfaye B Mersha, Shanfeng Zhu
pmc-13355592.description: Multi-omics interactions, including intra- and inter-omics interactions as well as socio-environmental influences, are key to uncovering molecular mechanisms that may be missed by individual omics analysis or conventional integration approaches. Deep learning offers a promising solution to overcome current limitations, including the complexity of modeling high-dimensional, nonlinear interactions, limited sample size and multiple testing burden.

pmc-13558272.title: Prevalence and Outcomes of Suspected Dysphagia in Elderly Inpatients Undergoing Cardiac Rehabilitation
pmc-13558272.creator: Naoto Miyawaki, Akira Takashima

pmc-13668397.title: Revising the TIGER 2018 Health Informatics Competency Framework: Updated Core Competency Areas for Nurses in a Digital Health Era
pmc-13668397.creator: Ursula H. Hübner, Nicole Egbert, Kaija Saranto, Polun Chang, Ann Kristin Rotegård, Inge Cort Madsen, Zulma González, Elske Ammenwerth, Jen Bichel-Findlay, Marion J. Ball
pmc-13668397.description: BackgroundIn 2018, the “TIGER International Recommendation Framework of Core Competencies in Health Informatics for Nurses” was published and used worldwide as a global guidance for educators and students to navigate educational requirements in an increasing digital working environment.ObjectiveRecent developments in digital health point to the need to revise these recommendations.
